items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: a septet called Jovenes Sociales. They were from Regla. The director's name was Jose Salinas. We called him Cheo. There I played guitar.

ctx.x: And what instrument did you play?

There I played the bass. Later there was another conjunto, septet from, the town of Regla - a septet called Jovenes Sociales. They were from Regla. The director's name was Jose Salinas. We called him Cheo. There I played guitar.
